workload: Richards, 3000 repetitions in one artifact process

profile_analysis.counting_method: Terminal call-tree frame counts are mutually exclusive and sum to 98; parent stack counts are inclusive. Allocator and memory-move stacks may be nested under native_list_set.
profile_analysis.interpretation: Most sampled CPU time was in generated native Richards code rather than the VM dispatch wrapper. The unsymbolicated JIT addresses and throttled sample do not distinguish branch work from allocation/copy work inside generated code.

interpretation: The run is valid because both the program output and the host profile passed their checks; the measured CPU attribution is a coarse profile, not a precise branch-versus-allocation measurement.
